overview: Twilight Ridge is the transition zone between the sun-blasted mesa and the deeper desert.
details: During Luclin’s twilight cycle, the red sands glow violet, weakening solar creatures and empowering dusk predators.
hooks: A twilight surge amplifies dusk predator activity.
Sun revenants retreat into crystal shadows.
A crystal-twilight anomaly pulses across the ridge.
A lost caravan is spotted near the violet cliffs.
